alpha_policy: Shader threshold only. Native pixels untouched. Camera-ray-only emission; original 3D keeper invisible to camera but retains shadow.
card_height_note: Camera-facing plane height equals projection of physical 1.76m vertical, not 1.76m in camera-up direction. Prevents inflated projected scale.
actual_silhouette_mapping: Native opaque character top/bottom align original evaluated 3D keeper head and shoe projected envelope, including projected shoe depth. Quad centered within old horizontal silhouette bounds. Physical landmark positions unchanged.
